title: The Step
description: 3D tactical grid on a phone: elevation and ramps, line of sight, area shapes, multi-tap moves and attacks.

title: The Loam
description: Map editor and system-free map book: draw a map with glyphs, place party, foes and objects, export encounters.

title: The Summoning
description: Character creation wizard: intent, class, abilities, equipment, with a step rail that shows how far you are.

title: The Effigy
description: Character sheet editor: start from a random stranger, every row is a tap, the cost of a class computed live.

title: The Table
description: d20 pinball: plunger, flippers, bumpers, three balls on a tilted plane.

title: The Cast
description: Spear throw: drag to cock, release, it sticks where it lands, three throws a round.

title: The Bowl
description: Dice bowling: flick a d6, d12 or d20 up the lane; a 1 busts, gutters count.

title: The Throw
description: Weapon flick at a spinning target: pull and release, centre hits pay.

title: Jenna & Travis wedding site
description: Invitation-styled single-page site for our January 2027 wedding: React + TypeScript, deployed on AWS with S3, CloudFront, Route 53 and an ACM certificate.
